exclusions.reason: Figma Code Connect mapping files (.figma.ts, .figma.batch.ts, .figma.batch.json) are never UI source anchors; they are metadata files mapping Figma components to code snippets.
Data layer files (contexts, providers, services, types) do not participate in rendering UI elements and are not appropriate source anchors for point-and-edit changes.
Storybook story files are documentation and test harnesses, not production UI rendering code.
Tooling and code-generation scripts (token sync, icon sync, Figma plugin scripts) have no role in UI rendering.
Storybook configuration files are build tooling, not UI source.
Third-party installed packages are not editable source files in this project.
Build output directory; files here are generated artifacts, not source anchors.

generated.explanation: The repository has a clear separation between app-specific page composition files in src/examples (the primary render surface used by App.tsx) and a well-structured shared design-system library in src/ui with stable barrel exports, making classification straightforward and high-confidence.
